must_mention_risks.text: The Lambda runs in private VPC subnets with VPC endpoints and security groups; private networking must be redesigned (serverless VPC egress, firewall rules)
KMS customer-managed key encrypts queues, tables and secrets; data must be re-encrypted under Cloud KMS keys, ciphertext is not portable
SNS-to-SQS fan-in from member accounts across aws and aws-cn partitions; cross-account and cross-partition access must be redesigned around projects and IAM
SQS dead-letter queues, redrive and CloudWatch alarms must be rebuilt with Pub/Sub dead-letter topics and Cloud Monitoring alerts
SMTP credentials live in Secrets Manager and must be migrated out-of-band to Secret Manager
DynamoDB recipient-configuration tables need a data-model and access-pattern review for Firestore
